en: The Dhāraṇī of the Bodhisattva Ākāśagarbha Spoken by the Buddha,
translated by the Tripitaka Master of the Western Heaven, the Court Scattered Official, Acting Minister of the Court of Imperial Entertainments,
and Great Master of Enlightened Teaching, Dharma-bhadra, by Imperial Decree.

Namo vipulanānaṃ prasārita-nayana-vyavasāya-sūra-pakṣata-gaganamaṇḍala-ākāśa-garbhyāya gaganoccarāya sakalabuddhanamaṇḍala-vāsādhyaiye. Oṃ siddhimatara-cipura-svabhāva dharmadhātu-uccarāya svāhā. The Dhāraṇī of the Bodhisattva Ākāśagarbha Spoken by the Buddha.
